defaults.notes: Assembled printed two-half research ball; Tag mechanically restrained and shell fully closed. Manual exploratory procedure without measured distance, speed, surface material, independent timing or video ground truth. Do not use as final threshold/model calibration.

episodes.label: stationary
episodes.notes: Ball resting untouched on the floor before manual motion episodes.

episodes.label: rolling
episodes.notes: Single light finger push, instructed travel approximately 30-80 cm, natural stop, no pickup. Distance and speed were not independently measured.

episodes.label: rolling
episodes.notes: Single subjectively stronger push in the opposite direction, instructed travel approximately 50-100 cm. The capture ended before a clean stationary tail, so it is not a settling-duration reference.

episodes.label: stationary
episodes.notes: Untouched post-roll check collected to rule out persistent gyro drift or mechanically loose internal motion.

episodes.label: pickup_carry
episodes.notes: Lifted approximately 20-30 cm, moved slowly left and right by hand, then gently placed back on the floor without a drop.

episodes.label: impact_tap
episodes.notes: Ball softly restrained from free rolling. The operator reports many light finger taps; the exact count and timestamps were not recorded. Setup/repositioning may also be present, so this is a repeated-tap episode and not clean per-impact ground truth.

episodes.label: stationary
episodes.notes: Untouched Ball used to physically validate timed ARMED capture: three-second pre-GO countdown, device-side action marker and five-second post-GO interval.
